job.title: Audit Senior
job.description:
About the Company:
Our client is an accounting firm in the Cayman Islands with a global presence. This firm offers excellent work life balance, a positive environment and favourable working hours.


About the Opportunity:
We are looking for newly qualified Audit Seniors. This is an exciting opportunity to progress your career and gain offshore financial services experience. 


About You:
You’ll be a fully qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, CPA, etc.) with at least 2-3 years of experience working at a Big 4 or Top 10 firm. Prior financial services audit experience will be advantageous.

job.title: Q4 2026 Start - Audit Opportunities for Seniors, Assistant Managers & Managers
job.description:
About the Opportunity:
Are you an experienced audit professional planning your next career move for the second half of 2026? I work closely with leading international audit firms and boutique practices across the Cayman Islands, offering early access to upcoming vacancies and market insights to support your transition.

Whether you're currently on island or overseas and considering relocation later this year, apply to this advert to arrange a confidential, exploratory consultation tailored to your experience and long?term career goals.

 

About You:
I’m keen to speak with Audit Seniors, Assistant Managers, and Managers with strong external audit experience, ideally from Big 4 or top-tier firms. If you’re used to leading engagements, supervising teams, and delivering high?quality client service, I can guide you through roles expected to open for the next September 2026 intake, salary expectations and potential relocation packages as well as market insights on culture, team structures and progression.

 

All conversations are strictly confidential. Apply now to start planning your next career step in the Cayman Islands.

job.title: Account Manager / Senior Account Manager
job.description:
About the Opportunity 

We are hiring Account Managers and Senior Account Managers to support a diverse portfolio of insurance and reinsurance captives. These roles sit within an established captive management team and involve end-to-end responsibility for client relationships, financial reporting, regulatory filings, and coordination with auditors, regulators, and service providers.

At Senior Account Manager level, you’ll take ownership of larger, more complex captives, act as a trusted client advisor, and mentor junior team members, while playing a key role in service delivery, governance, and strategic oversight.

About You

You might be an Audit Senior with a predominantly insurance or captive portfolio, now looking to move into industry and build deeper client ownership, or an experienced Captive Account Manager ready to step up into a Senior Account Manager role.

You bring a strong understanding of insurance accounting, financial statements, and regulatory reporting, along with excellent stakeholder management skills. You’re confident liaising with auditors and regulators, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client relationships. Experience with captives, reinsurance structures, or international insurance programs is highly regarded, as is a recognized accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA).

job.title: Ongoing Investment Analyst & Accounting opportunities

About You:

I can guide you through the market and support with live and upcoming roles at the family offices as well as discuss salary expectations, career progression prospects and why working in a family office can be one of the most sought-after positions on-island.

 

All conversations remain strictly confidential. Apply now to register for future opportunities and take the next step in your career in the Cayman Islands.

job.title: Internal Audit Senior / Manager
job.description:
About the Company
A leading global consulting firm in the Cayman Islands, renowned for its collaborative culture, commitment to professional development, and reputation as one of the best places to work on the island. Due to continued growth, the firm is seeking an Internal Audit Senior Associate or Manager to join its expanding team.

 

About the Opportunity
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced internal audit professional to join a high-performing team delivering internal audit engagements across a diverse portfolio of regulated organisations. You will be involved in the planning, execution, and delivery of internal audit projects, helping organisations strengthen governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks.
 

The role offers exposure to a broad range of industries, complex business environments, and senior stakeholder interaction, providing an excellent platform for professional development and career progression within a respected global organisation.
 

About You
You will have completed a professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIA or equivalent) with a minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience. Previous experience in Internal Audit or IT Audit within a professional services firm is essential. 


You will possess strong analytical and communication skills, a solid understanding of internal controls, governance, and risk management principles, and the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

job.title: Junior IT Officer
job.description:
Job Summary

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Junior IT Solutions Officer on behalf of a well-established organisation within the financial services sector. This role is ideally suited to an early-career IT professional or recent graduate looking to build technical expertise in a fast-paced, professional environment. You will support business applications, technology systems, digital initiatives, and end users while contributing to the smooth operation and continuous improvement of IT services.

Company Information

Join a respected and growing organisation operating within the banking and financial services industry. The business is committed to innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, with a strong focus on leveraging technology to enhance customer experience and business performance.

You will become part of a supportive technology team that works closely with stakeholders across the organisation to deliver reliable IT solutions, drive digital transformation, and maintain high service standards. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career while working alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

As the Junior IT Solutions Officer, you will:

  • Provide first-line support for business applications and technology systems.
  • Troubleshoot and assist with resolving software, application, and system-related issues.
  • Support system testing, upgrades, implementations, and technology enhancements.
  • Assist with user account administration and access management activities.
  • Deliver technical support and guidance to employees across the organisation.
  • Maintain accurate IT documentation, procedures, and system records.
  • Contribute to IT projects, digital transformation initiatives, and process improvement activities.
  • Liaise with external vendors and support cybersecurity, compliance, business continuity, and onboarding activities.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • An Associate's Degree or Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of IT experience, or be a recent graduate with relevant internships or project experience.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and business systems would be advantageous.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A good understanding of business applications and technology systems.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
  • The ability to work independently, collaborate within a team, and demonstrate a willingness to learn and develop new technical skills.

Benefits and Perks

In return, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Join a forward-thinking organisation undergoing an exciting period of growth and transformation.
  • Develop your IT career within the financial services sector.
  • Gain exposure to enterprise technology systems, digital initiatives, and business-critical applications.
  • Work alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and collaborative environment.
  • Contribute directly to technology improvements and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Expand your technical knowledge through hands-on project involvement and continuous learning opportunities.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, teamwork, and professional development.

This role is only open to Caymanian candidates and only suitable applications will be considered and contacted.

job.title: Cloud Developer
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation seeking a talented Cloud Microservices Developer to join its growing technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced software developer who is passionate about cloud computing, microservices architecture, API development, and scalable application design. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining modern cloud-native solutions that support critical business operations and digital innovation.

Company Information

Join a forward-thinking organisation operating within a technology-driven environment that places a strong emphasis on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The company is investing heavily in modern cloud technologies and digital transformation initiatives, creating an exciting landscape for skilled software professionals.

You will become part of a highly collaborative team of developers, engineers, and technical specialists who are committed to delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing cloud solutions. The culture encourages knowledge sharing, professional development, and the adoption of industry best practices.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Cloud Microservices Developer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices using modern development frameworks and best practices.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs, with exposure to GraphQL or gRPC where required.
  • Develop and deploy cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Create and manage containerised applications using Docker and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes or managed cloud services.
  • Implement event-driven architectures and integrate systems using messaging and streaming technologies including Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or EventBridge.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines, improving deployment efficiency and reliability.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise application performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilisation.
  • Produce technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and support ongoing platform enhancement and incident resolution.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience developing enterprise-level software applications.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience building and implementing microservices-based solutions.
  • Strong experience with Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, Go, Python, or similar modern programming languages.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD tools, and automated testing methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of API security standards including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT authentication.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and analytical skills, with experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban.

Desirable Skills

The following would be advantageous:

  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Hexagonal Architecture, or Clean Architecture.
  • Apache Kafka and event-driven architecture experience.
  • Service Mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Observability and monitoring tools including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Kubernetes certifications.

Benefits and Perks

In return for your expertise, you can expect:

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and microservices technologies.
  • Exposure to large-scale, business-critical cloud platforms and distributed systems.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Ongoing professional development and training opportunities.
  • Career progression within a growing technology function.
  • Participation in innovative projects that drive digital transformation.
  • A culture that values continuous learning, technical excellence, and employee growth.

job.title: Technical Lead
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation for an experienced Technical Lead to join its growing technology team. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology professional with strong leadership skills, software development expertise, and a strategic mindset to lead technical projects, manage development teams, and help shape the future direction of technology initiatives.

Company Information

This opportunity is with a forward-thinking organisation operating within the technology and software development sector. The company is known for delivering innovative digital solutions, maintaining high technical standards, and fostering long-term relationships with clients and technology partners.

You will be joining a collaborative and ambitious team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development. The culture encourages knowledge sharing, teamwork, and a proactive approach to solving complex technical challenges while delivering outstanding results for clients.

Responsibilities and Duties

As the Technical Lead, you will:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of software development projects.
  • Oversee day-to-day technology operations and drive operational efficiency across the development function.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors and external development partners.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Supervise, mentor, and motivate software development and support teams.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Define development priorities and contribute to the technology roadmap based on business and client requirements.
  • Ensure software solutions meet quality, security, and cloud infrastructure best practice standards.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years' experience leading operations or technical teams within a technology-focused environment.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience leading software development projects and managing cross-functional technical teams.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management principles.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking abilities with a results-driven approach.
  • Experience with cybersecurity best practices and secure cloud environments would be advantageous.

Benefits and Perks

In return, you can expect:

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Opportunity to lead impactful software development and technology projects.
  • Exposure to modern cloud technologies and innovative solutions.
  • A collaborative and supportive working environment.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The chance to influence technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • A culture that values innovation, continuous improvement, and employee contributions.
  • Engagement with clients, vendors, and industry-leading technology partners.

job.title: Caymanian Financial Controller
job.description:
About the Company
A dynamic and growing organisation committed to operational excellence, innovation, and delivering high-quality products. The business offers a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where employees are encouraged to contribute to its continued success.
 

About the Opportunity
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Financial Controller to join a high-performing leadership team. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will lead the company's accounting function, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities. You will also play a key role in driving process improvements, strengthening financial controls, and providing strategic financial insight to support business growth. In addition, you will mentor and develop the finance team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 

About You
You will be a fully qualified accounting professional (CPA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) with a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. You will bring a minimum of eight years' accounting experience preferably in a Finance Manager or Financial Controller role, with a proven track record of leading finance teams and delivering accurate financial reporting.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a qualified Financial Reporting Accountant to join a professional team supporting captive insurance companies. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing complex financial statements, managing financial reporting deadlines, and liaising with local and overseas service providers. You will also work closely with auditors, banks, and other financial institutions to ensure reporting requirements are met accurately and efficiently.

About You

You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, along with a recognised professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, or CPA. You will have at least two years of post-qualification experience gained within a public accounting environment and possess strong financial reporting skills. The ideal candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel, communicate effectively in both written and spoken English, and demonstrate exceptional organisational skills with a keen eye for detail.

job.title: Managing Director
job.description:
About the Company
Our client is an international group with a growing presence in the Cayman Islands and operations spanning multiple jurisdictions.

 

About the Opportunity
This is a highly visible senior leadership role with broad responsibility for the leadership and oversight of the Cayman-based management services business and the support it provides to Group entities.

 

Working closely with Boards of Directors and senior leaders across Treasury, Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance, the successful individual will act as a trusted adviser and central point of coordination between Group companies, professional advisers, regulators, service providers, and other key stakeholders.

 

About You
You’ll have a legal, accounting, fiduciary, or related professional background, ideally supported by a recognized qualification such as attorney, CPA, CA, or STEP. This is a broad remit that will be more defined by candidate a caliber than prescriptive experience and qualifications. Experience with treasury and banking oversight, cross-border structures, and/or UHNW principals will be highly valued.

job.title: Valuations Manager
job.description:
About the Company

About the Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced valuation professional who enjoys working on complex engagements and managing a diverse client portfolio. As a Manager, you will oversee and mentor staff and be responsible for a portfolio of valuation and financial modeling assignments across financial services clients.

 

About You
You will be a fully qualified accountant (ACA, CPA, CA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) and bring a minimum of five years experience in valuations, financial modeling, or related advisory services.

job.title: Advisory Senior Associate
job.description:
About the Company

About the Opportunity

job.title: Head of Credit
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is a leading Cayman Islands bank with a strong reputation for excellence, innovation, and prudent risk management. As part of its continued growth, the bank is seeking an experienced credit professional to lead its Credit function and drive portfolio performance across multiple banking segments.  

About the Opportunity

The Head of Credit will work closely with Executive Management, support lending growth across Premium, Private and Corporate Banking, and ensure the highest standards of credit quality and risk management.

job.title: Account Manager

job.title: Fund Accountant

job.title: Tax Senior
job.description: This is an extremely unique opportunity to practice US taxation in the Cayman Islands.  You’ll get the opportunity to work on some of the most interesting partnerships, individual and corporate structures imaginable and gain invaluable experience. Whilst working at a global, market leading firm, you’ll get the benefits this affords, and enjoy a beach lifestyle, tax-free salary and no commute in the beautiful Cayman Islands.

job.title: Associate - Corporate
job.description:

From M&A, joint ventures, and VC to crypto and fintech regulatory, this law firm really handles everything you can imagine in the corporate space.

Join our client’s global firm in the Cayman Islands for a challenging yet balanced professional environment, and enjoy the unique lifestyle this desirable location offers.

job.title: Associate - Trust & Private Wealth
job.description:
About our client:
Our client is a leading, independent provider of specialised corporate, trust and fiduciary services with a wide network that allows them to provide reliable service. Their international client base includes some of the world’s top law firms, investment funds, financial institutions and high-net-worth individuals.

About the position: 
As an Associate, you will be working as a part of a dynamic team, acting as a point of contact in both contentious and non-contentious private client work, including trust and supplemental deed drafting, advisory work, will drafting, family office planning, wealth structuring, probate applications, trust applications and trust related disputes. 

About you: 

You must be a qualified associate within a relevant jurisdiction* with a minimum of 5 years post-qualification experience in all aspects of private client work. Desired skills include an ability to provide accurate, focused advice to clients and a proven ability to work both autonomously and as a part of a team.

* Cayman Islands, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada

For more information or to apply, contact graham.blyth@cml.ky for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Crypto Accountant
